name: Corn/Soybean Price Ratio: Seasonal Analysis & Planting Season Norms
description: Analyzes the corn/soybean price ratio over 3 years, examining seasonal patterns and current positioning relative to historical norms heading into planting season (March–June). Computes daily ratio with 20-day SMA, average ratio by calendar month, year × month heatmap, and summary statistics including current ratio, 3-year average, high/low, percentile rank, and planting-season average.
source:
# =============================================================================
# CORN / SOYBEAN PRICE RATIO — SEASONAL ANALYSIS & PLANTING SEASON NORMS
# =============================================================================
# Computes daily ZC/ZS ratio with 20-day SMA overlay, monthly seasonal profile,
# year × month heatmap, and summary stats (current, avg, high, low, percentile,
# planting-season avg). Planting season = March through June.
# =============================================================================

# --- Data: Corn (primary asset) ---
src_corn = market_data_source()()
cont_corn = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardPanamaCanal)(src_corn.o, src_corn.h, src_corn.l, src_corn.c, src_corn.v, src_corn.oi, src_corn.s)
close_corn = cont_corn.c

# --- Data: Soybeans (reference) ---
src_soy = reference_futures(ticker='ZS')()
cont_soy = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardPanamaCanal)(src_soy.o, src_soy.h, src_soy.l, src_soy.c, src_soy.v, src_soy.oi, src_soy.s)
close_soy = cont_soy.c

# =============================================================================
# RATIO & SMOOTHING
# =============================================================================

ratio = close_corn / close_soy
ratio_sma = ma(period=20, type=MAType.sma)(ratio)

# =============================================================================
# DATE COMPONENTS
# =============================================================================

bar_ts = index()
bar_month = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.month)(bar_ts)
bar_year = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.year)(bar_ts)

# =============================================================================
# DERIVED METRICS FOR SUMMARY TABLE
# =============================================================================

# Percentile rank of current ratio vs trailing 756 bars (~3 years daily)
ratio_pctrank = percentrank(period=756)(ratio)

# Planting season filter: March (3) through June (6)
is_planting = 1 if (bar_month >= 3 and bar_month <= 6) else 0
planting_ratio = where(is_planting > 0, ratio)

# =============================================================================
# CHART 1: Daily Ratio Time Series with 20-day SMA
# =============================================================================

xy_lines(
    title='Corn/Soybean Price Ratio (3-Year Daily)',
    category='Ratio Analysis',
    y_axis_label='ZC / ZS Ratio',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=3,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Daily Ratio', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='20-Day SMA', color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.Solid)
    ]),
    order=0
)(bar_ts, ratio, ratio_sma)

# =============================================================================
# CHART 2: Average Ratio by Calendar Month (Seasonal Profile)
# =============================================================================

xy_bars(
    title='Which Months Show the Highest Corn/Soybean Ratio?',
    category='Ratio Analysis',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=True,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=3,
    y_axis_label='Avg ZC/ZS Ratio',
    x_axis_label='Month',
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=1
)(values=ratio, label=bar_month)

# =============================================================================
# CHART 3: Year × Month Heatmap
# =============================================================================

# Monthly ratio for heatmap — use monthly timeframe data
src_corn_m = market_data_source(timeframe=1M)()
cont_corn_m = futures_continuation(timeframe=1M, s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardPanamaCanal)(src_corn_m.o, src_corn_m.h, src_corn_m.l, src_corn_m.c, src_corn_m.v, src_corn_m.oi, src_corn_m.s)
close_corn_m = cont_corn_m.c

src_soy_m = reference_futures(ticker='ZS')()
cont_soy_m = futures_continuation(timeframe=1M, s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardPanamaCanal)(src_soy_m.o, src_soy_m.h, src_soy_m.l, src_soy_m.c, src_soy_m.v, src_soy_m.oi, src_soy_m.s)
close_soy_m = cont_soy_m.c

ratio_monthly = close_corn_m / close_soy_m

monthly_ts = index(timeframe=1M)
month_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.month)(monthly_ts)
year_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.year)(monthly_ts)

heatmap(
    title='Corn/Soybean Ratio: How Does Each Year Compare?',
    category='Ratio Analysis',
    x_axis_label='Month',
    y_axis_label='Year',
    min_color=Color.Blue,
    max_color=Color.Amber,
    show_data_labels=True,
    data_label_format='{point.value:.3f}',
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    timeframe=1M,
    order=2
)(x=month_num, y=year_num, value=ratio_monthly)

# =============================================================================
# SUMMARY TABLE: Key Statistics
# =============================================================================

summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Corn/Soybean Ratio Summary',
        row_size=1,
        col_size=6,
        row_headers=['ZC/ZS Ratio'],
        col_headers=['Current Ratio', '3-Yr Average', '3-Yr High', '3-Yr Low', 'Percentile Rank', 'Planting Avg (Mar-Jun)'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3, grid_color=Color.Blue),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1, grid_color=Color.Teal),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=5, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3)
        ]
    ),
    category='Ratio Analysis',
    order=-1
)(ratio, ratio, ratio, ratio, ratio_pctrank, planting_ratio)
